title: Video Editing pinned native assets
description: Explicit per-OS native assets; source material carries only this manifest and resolver. Preparation is a separately authorized owner action.

revision.description: Immutable cache namespace; bump when any asset changes.

minimumMajor.description: Existing managed Node runtime selected by the platform PATH.

supply.description: Reuse platform runtime; do not download or pin a developer absolute executable.

license.description: Node license and third-party notices distributed by platform runtime.

id.description: Stable native dependency or full notice identifier.

url.description: Fixed maintainer/official archive URL; no latest, credentials or machine paths.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete downloaded original bytes; checked before any extraction.

maxBytes.description: Bound on download bytes to prevent unbounded disk consumption.

format.description: Deterministic extraction method; text assets are complete upstream notices.

executable.description: Relative cache path to the executable or complete text notice after extraction.

license.description: Actual dependency license scope, separate from editor MIT.

source.description: Corresponding maintained source or source provenance page.

assets.description: Native archives and full separate license/README texts, all pinned by original-byte SHA.

requiredNotices.description: Full archive license/notice files that must exist before the cache can be published.

targets.description: Exact OS/architecture keys: darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, win32-x64, linux-x64 and linux-arm64.
